# BidEyes
> BidEyes is an AI-assisted pre-bid document review service for commercial electrical contractors.

## Docs
- [Technology](https://hvax.dev/technology.html)
- [About](https://hvax.dev/about.html)

## Technical Approach
Customers email bid packages. Our system processes the documents to identify findings with source citations, followed by human estimator review. Customers receive reviewed reports. We are building on the Anthropic Claude API for document analysis.
